name.value: Clearwater Wells Gray Park Visitors Centre

description.value: The Clearwater Wells Gray Park Visitors Centre is operated by Information Wells Gray, a non-profit organization serving as the primary information hub for Wells Gray Provincial Park — one of BC's largest wilderness parks at over 5,000 km². Touring cyclists passing through Clearwater can access up-to-date trail reports, road conditions, and park regulations, as well as guidance on camping, canoeing, hiking, and wildlife. The centre is the logical first stop for anyone planning to explore the park's iconic waterfalls, backcountry routes, or hut-to-hut trail system.
